answer: Each applicant receives one tagged timber stake and must wander a published transect, planting it only at coordinates derived from their address and the epoch seed. They then file a one-use sonnet whose stressed syllables encode the stake id and the trace hash. Settlement overlays traces against texts; reused stakes, coincident wander paths, or sonnets sharing a stress skeleton burn those seats, and those applicants are barred from the next two transects.
